heading: The first reader test needs revision.
scope: Six questions ran once. The retained answers exposed an ambiguous reference rule; the final acceptance process also failed.

requiredText: Five answers included the required evidence and one valid title reference excluded by the scoring key.
the supervisor closed that claim as a recorded failure without repeating any study stage.
The proposed next comparison uses a new independently authored cohort and explicit public reference-selection rules.

results.label: The retained answers
results.measure: included the required evidence and an excluded title reference
results.summary: One further answer abstained despite citing an explicit scope limit. The provisional exact-rule score was 0/6; it is not an accepted accuracy result.

results.label: The interrupted check
results.summary: A process-inventory timeout interrupted acceptance. Independent review and a verified backup supported closing the original claim as failure.

limits: Six selected cases; no accepted score, general-accuracy estimate, human study or graph-versus-text comparison. Valid extra references are not fabricated citations.

next.question: Can clearer reference rules make the test more useful?
next.description: Use new independently authored cases to test explicit reference-selection rules, while retaining checks for false evidence and appropriate abstention.
next.budget: First complete the automatic failure handoff. Preserve this run; do not tune its scoring key after seeing the answers.
